expected_output_contract: The rendered source landmarks should coincide with the printed diagram at t=0. This requires correct upstream geometry as well as correct transforms.
expected_diagram: Ground the whole lens/axis, object base and tip, image base and tip, focal markers and ray paths independently. A missing object detection must remain missing evidence, not become an assumed exploration object.
finding: Thin-lens runtime returns u=234, v=234, magnification=−1. No numerical solver defect is established. The actual t=0 renderer makes already incorrect source geometry visible.
change_or_loss: Overlay image is captured from the actual canvas/SVG and projected back using measured DOM-to-source ratios. No objects were manually repositioned.
